text.tspan: Chlorophyll-a Mapping and Prediction in the Mar Menor
The Mar Menor, a hypersaline coastal lagoon in southeastern Spain, has undergone
recurrent eutrophication events that demand accurate and continuous monitoring of
water quality. This study presents an open and reproducible framework that integrates
Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and in situ data to predict and map Chl-a concentrations
across multiple depths of the water column.
